title: ExplanationService
responsibility: Matches recorded reasons to the changes that need them by exact content fingerprints.

inputs.name: ExplanationService.report.required
inputs.description: The changes that need a reason, each with its unit, symbol, optional file, change kind and the content fingerprints it goes from and to, which are null where there is no earlier or later content. A requirement is explained when a chain of recorded reasons for exactly the same unit, symbol and file leads from its from to its to; otherwise it is stale when a recorded reason for that subject starts at its from, and missing when none does.

inputs.name: ExplanationService.report.explanations
inputs.description: The recorded reasons to match against the requirements, in the order given; where several reasons leave the same content, the one given last is used for that step. The service reads only the unit, symbol, file, from, to, behavior and both attempt texts; the change, outcome and recordedAt values are passed through unchanged.

inputs.name: ExplanationService.report.writing
inputs.description: The version of the writing limits that the revision these changes lead to declares, or null when it declares none; overlong and the writing-limit problems in failures are judged under that version. Defaults to null, which lists no writing-limit problem in failures, while overlong is judged under writingVersions[0], which is version 1.

inputs.name: describe.status
inputs.description: The requirement to describe, with its unit, symbol (where '*' names the whole unit), optional file, change kind, fingerprints and state, which is explained, missing or stale. A stale state ends the message with 'after its reason was written', and any other state, including explained, ends it with 'without a reason'.

outputs.name: ExplanationService.report
outputs.description: The result of one check: each requirement with its state, the reasons that satisfy them in requirement order, the requirements with an overlong reason, and the failure messages. Failures lists the describe message of each requirement that is not explained, then each writing-limit problem of a used reason under the writing version given; when writing is null it lists no writing-limit problem.
